verdict.rationale: Open WebUI exposes API keys for external programmatic access (docs-2), a gateway that presents workspaces as an OpenAI-compatible model any client can call (docs-33), a single-command CLI 'cptr run' (docs-38), and built-in scheduled/automated prompt tasks (docs-5, docs-14, docs-31) — all of which support headless/automated invocation outside the chat UI. However, Open WebUI is fundamentally a self-hosted web UI (Docker/pip/k8s deploy) and there is no explicit documentation or community evidence of running it in a CI pipeline or fully headless test-automation context. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration guidance, independent confirmation of headless operation, and evidence of automated test-suite usage beyond docs claims.
